title.zh: Bitget $388M Hack: CEO Cites Bybit's 3.5% Freeze Rate
title.en: Bitget $388M Hack: CEO Cites Bybit's 3.5% Freeze Rate

current_state.zh: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen addressed recovery efforts following a $388M hack at the exchange, contrasting them with Bybit's $1.5B breach and citing Bybit's 3.5% freeze rate as a comparative benchmark.
